column1: # APPROXIMATE TEST VALUES ONLY: rough literature-order estimates for UI development
# Lines starting with '#' are skipped by the parser (Papa Parse "comments" option).
#   surface_temp_range_c   typical annual (Earth/Mars) or diurnal-to-seasonal (Moon) span
#   median_slope_deg       median terrain slope at ~100 m baseline
#   soil_match             0..1 similarity of soil/regolith to the analog target (1 for target sites themselves)
#   sun_max_elev_deg       maximum solar elevation over the year
#   ground_ice             0..1 likelihood / abundance index of near-surface ice
#   analog_of              mars | moon | — (target sites themselves use —)
